description.en:
After the fall of the empire due to the homunculi, Evienrose, the 7th Princess, dies after drinking poison given by her younger sister who has taken their side. When she opens her eyes again, she has returned 8 years to the past. To stop the fall of the imperial family, Eve decides to turn 'Mikhael', the leader of the homunculi and the 'Monster of the Floating Prison', into her appointed knight.

"Mikhael, I need you, very much."

---
Princess Evienrose, despite advocating fiercely for the rights of the homunculi rebels, now awaits death at their hands… that is until she is poisoned by her own sister! Awakening eight years in the past, Eve now has one goal: become the Empress and liberate the homunculi to stop the rebellion from ever happening! To do this, she appoints the rebel king himself, Mikaelis Agnito, as her personal knight. But with Eve’s scheming sisters standing in the way, the fight for the crown is on, and the fate of the Hadelamid empire rests in her hands!

---
The seventh imperial princess, Evenrose, once died. Her last memory was of the royal family was destroyed by the Homunculus, the rebelling slaves, and of her sister who had sided with the rebels and urged her to escape her painful execution by swallowing poison. But when she opened her eyes again, "I...I'm not dead." She realizes that she had gone eight years back in time, back to a time before her cruel sister Bridgette was chosen as the next emperor. Given the opportunity to prevent the fall of the imperial family by being chosen as the next emperor herself, she decides to write her own article about Michael, the king of Homunculus and the monster of public prison, in order to win the emperor's heart. "I need you, Michael. Very badly." Will Evenrose be able to get him and protect the imperial family safely?

description.fr:
Il était une fois, un royaume où grâce à une alchimie interdite, des homonculus étaient créés.

Ces homonculus devaient se soumettre à la volonté de la famille Impériale à l’aide d’une magie d’asservissement. Les plus doués d’entre eux faisaient partie de la garde du château et parmi eux, la famille Impériale devait en choisir un pour en faire leur chevalier personnel. Mais un homonculus résista au sort de l’Empereur: Mikhaelis Agnito.

Il organisa une rébellion, souleva les homonculus contre l’empire et exécuta toute la famille Impériale à l’exception de la 7ᵉ princesse, Evenrose et la 8ᵉ princesse, Rosenite. Cette dernière, éperdument amoureuse de Mikhaelis, croyait qu’elle portait en elle le «résultat de leur amour.» Elle pensait être exceptionnelle mais elle n’était en vie qu’uniquement parce qu’elle avait subit une expérience avec la pierre philosophale, qui ne fonctionnait seulement qu’avec le sang royal. Une simple marionnette que Mikhaelis pouvait contrôler à sa guise.

Cependant, le traître avait des sentiments pour Evenrose, car elle était différente. Elle était contre l’utilisation des homonculus comme esclaves et étudia durement pour leur rendre leur liberté, faisant d’elle le mouton noir de la famille Impériale. Malheureusement, elle ne comprit pas les actions de Mikhaelis et croyait qu’elle allait se faire exécuter comme les siens.
Rosenite en profita pour venir la voir et l’empoisonner, se réjouissant de la mort de sa demi-sœur, pensant avoir Mikhaelis pour elle seule. En apprenant la nouvelle de la mort d’Evenrose, Mikhaelis tente alors par tous les moyens de la ressusciter. Un mage lui proposa un moyen: celui de retourner dans le temps. Néanmoins, seule Evenrose gardera les souvenirs de tout ce qui c’était passé jusqu’à présent. Mikhaelis accepta sans sourciller, du moment que sa bien aimée était en vie. Quand le sort se lança, Evenrose ouvrit les yeux et se retrouva 8 ans en arrière.

Sera-t-elle capable de changer son destin?

description.en: When Hazel Mayfield is sent to live with the Martins as a child, she falls in love with rural life and vows to have a farm of her own one day. Eleven years later, she receives an unexpected windfall as her grandfather hands her the deed to a plot of land in the middle of the capital. Ecstatic, Hazel sets out to realize her longtime dream of becoming a farmer. There’s only one problem: Her new farm is right next to the imperial palace! And it seems the emperor himself has his eye on her land…
description.fr: Hazel est l'unique héritière du baron Mayfield, mais elle nourrit un tout autre rêve: posséder une ferme. Alors quand son grand-père annonce lui léguer un petit terrain, elle est au comble de la joie. Malheureusement pour elle, les terres se trouvent au milieu du domaine d'un grand noble du pays, et pas n'importe lequel: l'empereur. Et celui-ci compte bien récupérer les droits sur la propriété. Mais c'est sans compter le vent du bonheur qu'apporte Hazel avec elle.
description.id: Seorang ahli bertani yang memiliki 'tangan matahari', Hazel Mayfield. Dia pergi mencari ladang pertanian miliknya sambil membawa surat tanah yang diberikan oleh kakeknya. "Selama nama saya tertulis di surat tanah, tidak akan ada siapa pun yang bisa merebut tanah itu dari saya!" Namun ternyata, tanah miliknya berada tepat di samping istana kaisar dan tidak lama lagi akan dijadikan sebagai tanah untuk membangun kebun besar dalam istana. Akankah Hazel berhasil melindungi ladang pertaniannya?

위대한 브라타니아 제국의 젊은 황제 이스칸다.
완전무결한 황궁을 꿈꾸던 그에게 닥친 최대 위기.

"땅문서에 제 이름이 적혀 있는 한 누구도 저한테서 이 땅을 빼앗을 수 없어요!"

황궁 한가운데서 알박기라니요?
아침마다 코를 자극하는 거름 냄새.
일생일대의 숙적이 된 소녀는 황제의 친구들까지 슬금슬금 포섭해나가는데…

"더는 좌시할 수 없다. 이건 황제에 대한 명백한 도전이야!"
description.ru: Барон выигрывает в аукционе землю, рядом с которой развернулось строительство нового дворца. И для полного счастья императору остаётся выкупить лишь этот несчастный участок, что уже как бельмо на глазу. Однако хитрый обедневший дед решил пополнить карманы, поэтому он заламывает баснословную цену, а затем отправляет туда свою внучку, говоря, что этот участок – подарок для неё. Не желая узурпировать земли, молодой император, мечтающий о величественном замке, который будет достоин его великих свершений, старается не обращать внимания на спекулянтов. Но если бы он только знал, что его новая соседка станет врагом всей его жизни... Ведь Хейзел Мэйфилд мечтает о собственной ферме. Она обладает способностью "Рука Солнца", что позволяет ей оживить даже самый гиблый росток. - Чем это так воняет? - Пахнет навозом, Ваше Величество. "Как достать соседа" начинается!
description.uk:
Хейзел - дівчина, що володіє даром під назвою "Руки сонця", одна з небагатьох, кому саме небо назначило працювати з природою. Знаючи про її мрію утримувати ферму, її дідусь, барон Мейфілд, подарував онучці ділянку землі, одначе є одна проблема... Вона знаходиться на території імператорського палацу!

Несподівана зміна обставин не дає спокою молодому імператору:
"Мій простір залишиться недоторканим!"

Хейзел повна намірів втілити мрію всього свого життя:
"Я залишусь тут за будь-яких обставин!"

description.en:
When I first came into the book, my goal was just to survive.

‘I have to live longer! And be happy!’ So I did my best.

I am going to walk on my own flower path.

“Wherever I go, the seat next to you is mine. You promised to pat my head for the rest of your life, isn’t that right?” The strongest male character, who was stabbed to death in the original novel, stared at me with obsessive eyes.

If I say no, he will destroy the world.

“Yes, I’ll kill him. Then you’ll be happy, too, right?” The fifth brother looked a bit crazy.

“This is my land from here to here. And yours, too. I’m glad to be able to breathe with your grandest dreams.” The fourth oldest sister, who became the richest woman on the continent, opened the map and said that.

If I say I don’t have such a grand dream like her, I think a catastrophe will happen.

“I’m looking forward to the Winter Solstice that you’ll rule completely.” Laughter rose on the face of the butler who served me.

“If you don’t connect to Verratoux, my heart will stop tomorrow morning. Are you sure you’re okay with that?” My first sister, who was supposed to be the original successor, threatened me with her life.

And this is the biggest problem. Somehow, a faint smile raised my father’s mouth, which became stronger than the original father he was. “Independence? Try it then. I won’t even let a single ant live on this land.”

“Did you think you could leave my arms and stand on your own…” He then stared at me obsessively.

They are all acting weird.

Everything went wrong.

I only did my very best.

description.en:
Psyche Silkisia lived her whole life as a fill-in for the missing daughter of House Silkisia. Despite her attempts to be accepted by the family, they accuse her of murder and force Psyche to commit suicide. Devastated by this, Psyche swallows the poison she's given and miraculously finds herself in the past. Determined to live for her own sake this time, Psyche hurries to escape. But when her family suddenly refuses to let her go, she realizes that perhaps she isn't the only one who's changed...

---
I lived my whole life as a substitute for the lost princess. But the moment the real princess came back, “Let’s be thankful that it ends like this.”

I was sorrowfully abandoned. …No, the ending would have been the same even if the real princess had not returned.

“I think my usefulness is up to here, so I’ll leave now.”

“If you come back, I’ll acknowledge you as a real daughter.”

“I don’t need it.”

I wouldn’t be loved by anyone, but it didn’t matter. I decided to live my own life completely.

“It goes up high enough for everyone to look up to.”

“I’ll make it like that for you.”

“Don’t leave me. Do you get it?"

Whispering that he loves me, and even asking me if I knew it.
description.fr: Moi, Psyché Silkicia, j'ai lutté toute ma vie pour être acceptée. Adoptée par le duc à la disparition de sa fille, j'ai passé ma vie à jouer la remplaçante... Puis un jour, la vraie fille du duc a refait surface, et n'ayant plus besoin de moi, la fausse, ils m'ont poussée au suicide. Mais au lieu de mourir, j'ai été renvoyée dans le passé, au jour du retour de cette fille! Qu'à cela ne tienne, le duc a retrouvé sa fille? Eh bien moi, je vivrai enfin librement! Je ne serai plus un pâle reflet!
description.id: Walau terus disebut sebagai Putri Palsu, Psyche selalu berusaha keras demi mendapat pengakuan dari keluarganya, keluarga Duke Silkisia. Meski pada akhirnya... hidup Psyche harus berakhir saat dituduh membunuh Lillian, putri yang sesungguhnya. Di akhir hayatnya, Psyche berdoa, bilamana dia diberi kehidupan selanjutnya, dia akan hidup untuk dirinya sendiri, bukan untuk keluarga yang sedari awal tidak pernah menganggapnya.
description.ko:
**이제 내 모든 것을 되찾겠어.**

"내 자리는, 처음부터 없었구나…."

가짜 공녀라 손가락질 받으면서도 가족들의 인정을 받기 위해 헌신했지만,
모두에게 배신 당한 프시케는 진짜 공녀를 살해하려 했다는 누명을 쓴 채 죽음을 맞는다.

'내게 다음 생이 주어진다면, 절대로 이렇게 살지 않을 것이다.'

마지막 순간 떠올린 생각 덕이었을까.
프시케가 눈을 뜨자 진짜 공녀가 돌아오기 전 과거로 돌아가 있었다.

'당신들에게 휘둘렸던 모든 시간이 후회돼.'

다시 주어진 삶, 운명의 굴레에서 벗어나 가문이 아닌 나 자신을 위한 삶을 살겠다.

Меня бросили.

— Я сделаю для тебя все.

description.en:
Mia Evelan has never left the tiny room where her aunt and uncle keep her locked up. Then one night, she has a series of dreams that show her the future, and learns that her true father could be a demonic grand duke. Knowing this, Mia plans to escape her room and ask the grand duke for child support so she can strike out on her own. But once they've met, her father isn't intent on letting her go so easily! Should Mia choose a life of independence or one with her newly found demon family?

---
I'm Mia, a child abused by my family. One day I had a 'dream' and saw the future. A future where I fell for my aunt and uncle's schemes, accidentally murdered my older half-brother, and causing a great war. Things just can't end like this, so I'll change the future with my own hands! 

With the information gathered from the dream, the first thing I have to do is find my biological father!

"Gimme thild thupport!"

(If only I didn't lisp!) In return for selling information about my uncle's schemes and taking all the backlog of child support from my biological father, I was planning on leaving…

But then my eldest brother, who boasts an aloof beauty, said, "I'm thinking of building you an amusement park."

My reckless second eldest brother interrupted and said, "Shall I buy you a tropical island covered with pretty flowers?"

And the most handsome man in the world, my Papa, replied on a whole nother level! "I'll buy you an artifact which calls for mermaids."

No, no, no! All three have terrible liquidity! The cleverest, smartest, most materialistic, devilish answer is… "Please make me a slide made of pure gold!"
description.ko:
"양유삐 주세요!(양육비 주세요!)"

외숙부와 이모에게 학대를 받으며 살던 미아. 어느 날, 그녀는 꿈 속에서 자신이 외숙부의 계략에 넘어가 친오빠를 살해하고, 세계 멸망을 일으키는 미래를 보게 된다.

이렇게 죽을 수는 없지! 미래는 내 손으로 바꾼다!

미아는 친부에게 외숙부의 흉계를 팔아 넘기고, 밀린 양육비에 정보 비용을 얹어서 청구하기로 결심하는데...

나는 제법 심각한 표정을 지으며 입을 열었다. 양손도 자랑스레 펼쳐 보인 채였다.

"샤다 샤. 그삐 정보에 단됸 천 골드! (싸다 싸. 극비 정보에 단돈 천 골드!)"

저기, 세계 멸망을 막을 정보 사실래요?

_

"꽃이 예쁘게 피는 열대 섬 하나 사줄까?"
아벨이 이렇게 말하자마자,

"섬에 아무것도 없으면 심심할테니 큰 오빠가 놀이동산을 하나 지어줄까 해."
카이옌 오빠가 끼어들고,

"나는 인어를 부르는 아티팩트를 사주마. 그게 있으면 밤새 인어의 노래를 들으며 놀 수 있을 거다."
아빠는 한 술 더 뜬다!

나는 영리하고 똑똑한 속물 악마답게 공손히 입을 열었다.

"미끄럼틀은 순금으로 만들어 주세요."

She'd lost her mind!

description.en:
Laviore Bailey — the ‘fake saintess’ who banished the innocent princess and stirred up bad blood to wage war.

She’s the villainess with a façade of a saintess.

“I love you. So just shut your mouth and die. Okay?”

But the moment her trusted lover chose her as a sacrifice to the demon, and she realized her father was behind the plan, she killed herself by swallowing poison. It hurt. It was so painful that she could not even scream. But it was fine. Because she knew this was not the end.

“I will save you this time.”

Then, she came back for her second life. She was determined to rescue those who were unlucky because of her and restored her life back.

“You do whatever you want for the man in your dream.” Demian said with a rough smile. 

“I’ll also protect you the way I want to.”

---
Laviore Rea Bailey, the fake saint and heartless puppet of the merciless Prince Sidar, drinks poison on the day the prince is to give her up as an offering to the devil. Instead of dying, she wakes up 10 years in the past. Set on righting her previous wrongs, Laviore vows to save the slave Damian Rhode Drake, whom she had once framed as a spy. As she gets closer to the mysterious Damian, new feelings start to emerge, but will this former villainess truly be able to change her ways?
description.fr:
Laviore Bailey, la «fausse sainte» qui a banni la princesse innocente et attisé le sang-froid pour faire la guerre.

«Je t'aime. Alors ferme ta bouche et meurs. D'accord?»

Mais au moment où son amant de confiance l'a choisie comme sacrifice au démon et qu'elle réalise que son père est derrière le plan, elle se suicide en avalant du poison.

Ça fait mal. C'est si douloureux qu'elle ne peut même pas crier. Mais c'est bien, car elle a échappée au sacrifice.

«Je vais vous sauver cette fois.»

Puis elle est revenue pour sa seconde vie. Elle est déterminée à sauver ceux qui n'ont pas eu de chance à cause d'elle.
description.id: Laviore Bailey—'Saintess palsu' yang mengusir putri tak berdosa dan mengobarkan darah buruk untuk berperang. Dia adalah penjahat dengan penampilan seperti saintess. "Aku mencintaimu. Jadi tutup saja mulutmu dan mati. Oke?" Tapi saat kekasihnya yang terpercaya memilihnya sebagai korban iblis, dan dia menyadari ayahnya berada di balik rencana tersebut, dia bunuh diri dengan menelan racun. Sakit. Sangat menyakitkan hingga dia bahkan tidak bisa berteriak. Tapi bukan masalah. Karena dia tahu ini bukanlah akhir. “Aku akan menyelamatkanmu kali ini.” Kemudian, dia kembali untuk kehidupan keduanya. Dia bertekad untuk menyelamatkan mereka yang tidak beruntung karenanya dan memulihkan hidupnya kembali. “Lakukan apapun yang kau inginkan untuk pria dalam mimpimu.” Ucap Demian sambil tersenyum kasar. “Aku juga akan melindungimu sesuai keinginanku.”
description.ko:
오트안의 가짜 성녀, '라비오르 리아 베일리'
연인의 배신으로 악마의 제물로 바쳐지는 것이 결정된 날,
모든 걸 되돌려 바로잡을 기회를 주겠다는 신의 목소리를 듣게 된다.

"뭐든지 할게요. 시간을 되돌릴 수 있다면…!"

찰나의 망설임도 없이 돌아온 두 번째 삶.

라라는 자신만의 방식으로 하나둘 이전 삶의 과오를 청산해나가지만
'데미안 로드 드레이크', 저로 인해 불행을 겪은 남자를
행복하게 해주겠다는 계획만은 도무지 뜻대로 풀리지 않는다.

"나 정도면 제법 자랑할 만한 노예 아닌가?
앞으로 6개월 동안 내 마스터 레이디가 되는 건 어때."

노예의 신분에서 자유롭게 해주겠다는 제안도 거절,

"제가 원하는 건 마스터 레이디께서 다 해주십니다.
그러니 포상은 제 마스터 레이디께만 해주십시오."

왕족의 포상을 받을 뻔했던 기회도 무산.

번번이 제 예상을 빗나가는 남자가
허를 찌르는 한 마디를 던진 순간,

"라라, 나는 성녀를 찾고있어."

라라의 운명은 또 한 번 움직이기 시작하는데…
description.uk:
Лавіора Бейлі - "фальшива свята," яка вигнала невинну принцесу і розпалила ворожнечу, щоб розв'язати війну.

Вона - лиходійка з обличчям святої.

"Я люблю тебе. Тож просто закрий рота і помри. Гаразд?"

Але в ту мить, коли її вірний коханий обрав її в жертву демону, і вона зрозуміла, що за цим планом стоїть її батько, вона вбила себе, проковтнувши отруту.

Це було боляче. Було так боляче, що вона не могла навіть крикнути. Але це було добре. Бо вона знала, що це не кінець.

"Цього разу я тебе врятую."

Потім вона повернулася до свого другого життя. Вона була сповнена рішучості рятувати тих, кому не пощастило через неї, і повернути своє життя назад.

"Роби все, що хочеш для чоловіка зі свого сну," - сказав Деміан з усмішкою на вустах.

"Я також буду захищати тебе так, як захочу."

description.de: Dohee, die ihr Leben lang von ihrem Umfeld ausgenutzt wurde, erwacht nach einem tödlichen Motorradunfall im Körper von Debora Shimore, der Antagonistin einer beliebten Reverse-Harem-Webnovel. Sie beschließt, sich nicht länger ausnutzen zu lassen und ihr neues Leben als Schurkin zu genießen. Sie muss nur sicherstellen, dass Debora nicht ihr vorbestimmtes Ende als Gefangene im Kloster findet. Dafür braucht sie, so glaubt sie anfangs, nur der Protagonistin und ihrem Harem aus dem Weg zu gehen, doch schon bald wird sie gezwungen, aktiver zu werden und sich mit dem Goldenen Drachen einzulassen.
description.en:
She possessed a villainess who is known and hated for her evil acts in an unpopular novel. But because of her personality, it was extremely difficult for her to play the villainess role. But not for long…

“I’ll fix your dress according to your taste this instant!”

“My request.”

“O-Of course! As per your request, there’s only one piece available in the whole Empire.”

People around me listen to me well even if I just frown and sit still. Since I don’t have to live in difficulty, I decided to just comfortably live on as a villainess.

“Father. Is it necessary for you to solve formulas in this slow and inefficient way?”

I thought it would be good to be a rich villainess, so I used all my knowledge.

“Why don’t you give me the honor of escorting the Princess?”

I have had enough of dealing with my father, so why did an unexpected character suddenly appear? What if this person disrupts my plan?

---
Dohee lived as a pushover, died miserably, and was reborn in a novel as a notorious villainess. But it turns out that her new life is not without its perks, as Deborah Seymour is also the richest villain alive. Now, all that's left for her to do is lay low and enjoy her carefree lifestyle...if not for the fact that Deborah is fated to be sent to a monastery! Will this ex-doormat find a way to avoid yet another tragic ending, or will the challenges of being a villainess be too much for her?
description.fr:
Dohee a vécu comme une poule mouillée, a péri misérablement et a été réincarnée dans un roman en tant que vilaine notoire. Mais il s'avère que sa nouvelle vie n'est pas sans avantages, car Deborah Seymour est aussi la méchante la plus riche de l'Empire. Il ne lui reste plus qu'à faire profil bas et à profiter de son insouciance... Si ce n'est que Deborah est condamnée à être envoyée dans un monastère! Cette ancienne fainéante trouvera-t-elle un moyen d'éviter une nouvelle fin tragique, ou les défis d'une méchante seront-ils trop importants pour elle?

---
Debora Seymour est la pire vilaine jamais écrite: elle ne cesse de persécuter Mya, l’héroïne du roman, depuis qu’elle a appris que Pilaf Montes, l’homme dont elle est éprise, n’a d’yeux que pour elle. Mais quand Dohee, une étudiante en architecture, meurt et se réincarne dans sa peau, elle est bien contente d’être devenu quelqu’un qui ne se laisse pas marcher dessus. Elle va enfin pouvoir passer sa vie à se la couler douce!  Mais c’est sans compter une loi qui impose aux jeunes filles de famille noble à se marier à l’âge adulte. L’alternative est simple : acquérir un titre de noblesse. Mais par quel moyen? En l’achetant. Dohee va alors mettre au point un plan pour devenir riche.
description.hr:
Yoon Dohee, studentica arhitektonskog fakulteta, otkriva da ju njezine kolege i obitelj iskorištavaju za novac i kao besplatnu radnu snagu točno prije nego pogine u prometnoj nesreći.
Umjesto da zapravo umre ona se reinkarnira u ljubavni roman koji je nedavno čitala, ali ne kao glavni lik, nego kao glavni zlikovac i antagonist knjige Deborah Seymour.
Sada kao Deborah ona navigira novi život odmarajući se u bogatstu i raskoši, ali mora biti na oprezu jer je njezina reputacija duboko pod zemljom, a lik Debore u originalnoj knjizi završava svoju priču u tamnici.
description.id: Kehidupan Yoon Dohee, wanita naif yang kerap dimanfaatkan oleh orang sekitarnya berubah drastis. Setelah dia mengalami kecelakaan dan sekarat, dia merasuk ke dalam tubuh wanita jahat bernama Deborah Seymour. Deborah Seymour adalah seorang tokoh di novel reverse harem rating 19+ berjudul 'A Dark Thorn Through My Throat'. Karena tidak ingin ada orang lain yang tahu kalau sebenarnya Yoon Dohee adalah wanita naif, dia akhirnya belajar untuk menjadi jahat seperti Deborah Seymour. "Aku tidak akan hidup sebagai orang yang baik dan menyedihkan seperti di masa lalu. Aku akan terus hidup enak sebagai wanita jahat!"

description.ru:
Я переродилась в трагично-жестоком романе в ужасную злодейку, которую ненавидят, что бы она ни делала. Но разочарование было недолгим.

"Сейчас же сделайте платье по вкусу герцогини!"
"Чего-то вроде домашнего задания, разумеется, нет".
"Это единственный драгоценный камень в империи, который ты хотела".

Даже если я просто смирно сижу с недовольным выражением лица, окружающие люди ходят по струнке.
Разве есть необходимость быть тряпкой? Будет удобнее просто дальше жить как злодейка.

"Отец, обязательно ли решать пример таким медленным и неэффективным способом?"

Раз уж так вышло, я решила стать богатой злодейкой, поэтому воспользовалась всеми имеющимися знаниями.

"Как насчет того, чтобы оказать мне честь и позволить быть вашим эскортом?"

Мало было отца, мне еще неожиданно повезло с темной лошадкой, которой не было в планах.
description.uk:
Ду Хі опанувала тіло лиходійки одного непопулярного роману, яка була відома і ненависна всім за свої погані вчинки. Але через власний характер їй дуже важко правильно грати роль злодійки. Але ненадовго.. 

"Я зміню сукню згідно з вашим смаком негайно" 

"Моє прохання." 

"З-звісно! Згідно з вашим запитом, у всій імперії є лише одна річ." 

Люди навколо мене добре слухають, навіть якщо я просто хмурюсь і сиджу на місці. Оскільки мені не доводиться жити в труднощах, я вирішила просто комфортно жити у тілі лиходійки. 

«Батько, чи потрібно вам розв’язувати формули таким повільним і неефективним способом?» 

Я подумала, що було б добре бути багатою негідницею, тому використовувала усі свої знання. 

«Чому б вам не надати мені честь супроводжувати принцесу?» 

У мене досить багато справ з батьком, так чому раптом з’явився цей неочікуваний персонаж? Що, якщо ця людина спробує порушити мій план?

description.en:
In a world where gates suddenly appear and monsters emerge from them, hunter Yoon Min-jun lives burdened by guilt after losing his girlfriend, Jung Si-a, in a gate break incident.

One year after her death, on the anniversary of the tragedy, another disaster occurs at her grave… but this time, what emerges from the gate is not a monster.

It is Si-a herself.

The girlfriend he thought was dead has returned, but no longer as the person he once knew. She has become a dragon, the strongest living creature, and after spending an unimaginably long time searching for a way back to him, she now wants only one thing: to stay by Min-jun’s side… and make sure he did not find another girlfriend while she was gone.

description.en:
Byeolha Kim was happily married… until she wasn’t anymore. 

Betrayed by her best friend, she is no longer the bubbly, innocent girl she used to be. However, everything changes once again in an accident that causes her to reality-shift. Now she is stuck in a mysterious but familiar world, and it doesn’t help that her back-stabbing, husband-stealing ex-friend is there with her. 

Will she be able to weave her own happy reality, or is she doomed by the narrative?

description.en:
You know, sometimes you just gotta do what you gotta do to survive. Getting hit in the head with a liquor bottle? Yeah, no thanks. If booting my deadbeat dad to the curb is what it takes, then so be it. Who cares about being the 'good' daughter when your skull's not intact?

And honestly, this whole 'rebuilding the family and getting back home' plan? It started with a bit of divine intervention, or so they say about that land. Next thing I know, bam! I became Countess Validus, blessed by the gods and apparently a real estate mogul.

Then the "just trying to make my life easier" snowball started. A little business here, a tiny push towards the Magic Tower there (hey, free research!), pointing out a few flaws in some laws (someone had to!), maybe tossing a sponsorship bone or two (art can be an investment, right?), and... why not, a school? Knowledge is power, and all that jazz.

The thing is, I wasn't exactly expecting a fan club to spring up. My staff acts like I hung the moon. Then this one lord suddenly wants to be my shadow, apparently my word is gospel now, and someone even called me the hope of the nation! And the proposals? Don't even get me started. All I did was try to not get hit in the head again and maybe, just maybe, find a way back to my own couch. Why is everyone acting like I'm some kind of saint? It's beyond me.

사흘 뒤 겨우 눈을 뜬 '세라피'는 아버지부터 내쫓기로 했다.
후레자식이 되더라도 일단은 살아야 할 것 아닌가?

가정폭력범이자 도박중독자인 아비 놈의 작위를 빼앗아서
파탄난 가문을 되살리고 원래 세계로 돌아가겠어!

“신이 떠나간 땅을 찾았습니다!”

그렇게 자연히 원작을 건드려
신의 축복을 받은 발리두스 백작이 되었고,
 
“사업을 한번 해 볼까 하는데….”
“마탑에 들어가고 싶어요?”
“이 법안은 문제가 너무 많아요!”
“후원 한번 받아 볼래?”
“학교를 한번 세워 볼까?”

양심의 가책도 없이 계속 건드렸더니...
 
“아가씨! 아니, 주인님!”
“세라, 당신의 부하가 되겠어요.”
“세라가 하는 말이면 당연히 믿어야죠.”
“백작은 이 나라의 희망이야.”
“저를 받아주시겠습니까.”

그냥 저 편하려고 돈 벌고 명예를 쌓아 가는 것뿐인데
왜들 이렇게 몰려와서 떠받들고 충성 맹세하고 난리인지,
세라피는 도저히 알 수 없었다.

description.en:
Twenty-four-year-old job seeker 'Im Yooha' returns to her parents' house in tears after a series of job rejections following her college graduation. There, she encounters 'Ji Mingyu' the youngest son of the homeowners and the black sheep of the family.

At their first meeting, he rudely asks, "Are you the new helper who moved in today?" and behaves disrespectfully. Under the same roof with the immature young master she never wanted to get involved with, ro...mance? Absolutely not! Let's keep the line we should never cross between you and me.

altTitles.es-la: ¿Por qué estás tan obsesionado conmigo incluso cuando estoy muerta?

altTitles.en: Even When I'm Dead
Why Are You Obsessed? Even Though You're Dead

description.en: On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally.
description.ko:
결혼식 당일, 내 연인과 친구가 바람이 났다.
두 사람의 배신에 나는 죽었고, 다시 눈을 떴을 때는 과거로 회귀했다.
이건 신이 내린 축복이니 정당하게 복수할 기회가 주어졌다고 생각했다.
하지만……이 회귀가 끝나지 않는다.
복수에 실패하면 그들의 배신에 죽었고, 복수에 성공하면 사고로 죽고,
그렇게 몇 번을 죽고 죽고 또 죽기를 반복하던, 최후의 죽음에.
보고야 만다. 내 모든 죽음이 사고가 아닌, 제 3자에 의한 살인이라는 걸.
그래서 이번엔 죽은 척 위장하여 모든 걸 버리고 떠났다.
끝없이 날 죽이는 이 살인마를 찾아 반드시 복수하기 위하여.

title.en: The Youngest Is Trying to Prevent the World From Ending

altTitles.en: The Youngest Is Preventing the End of the World
The Youngest Child of the Family Is Preventing the World From Ending

altTitles.ja: 末っ子悪女、世界滅亡を阻止します！

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:
«La plus jeune et sotte, celle qui ne sait rien faire, mais qui cause des ennuis avec son joli minois.»

Exaspérée, je me suis à nouveau regardée dans le miroir et je me suis exclamée, «Pourquoi suis-je la 'plus jeune stupide' Diana Cartier!»

Dans le roman *Le fin ne peut pas la destruction du monde*, Diana est une femme maléfique qui commet des actes néfastes à répétition et subit un lavage de cerveau de la part du méchant, ce qui contribue grandement à la destruction du monde! Si quelque chose peut mal tourner pour la méchante, cela se produira. Mais quand quelque chose tourne mal pour moi, je me souviens plutôt de ma vie passée? J'étais une étudiante ordinaire dans ma vie passée, et j'ai pris ma décision lorsque j'ai réalisé que j'avais été réincarnée en Diana Cartier, la méchante du roman.

«Le monde va s'écrouler. Mais je ne vais pas laisser faire.»

Oui, je vais empêcher la fin du monde de mes propres mains! Et sauver mes frères de la conspiration en même temps! Attendez un peu. Qu'est-ce que c'est que cette chose noire sur le sol là-bas? Attendez. Ce visage, où l'ai-je déjà vu?

‹Est-ce Linus del Stein?!›

Pourquoi êtes-vous allongé là, Monsieur le Protagoniste du roman qui va détruire ce monde?

Diana et ses frères font de leur mieux pour empêcher la fin du monde! Et des animaux mignons et d'autres choses? Notre adorable petit dernier est en train d'empêcher la fin du monde, pousse-toi de là!
description.ko:
#원작환생, #영지물 #악녀였던 여주, #여주한테만착한오빠들, #여주한테만순한남자주인공, #사이다 전개, #약간의 착각물

“할 줄 아는 건 아무 것도 없으면서 귀여운 얼굴만 믿고 폐를 끼치는 멍청한 막내, 걔.”

분개한 나는 다시 한 번 거울을 보고 외쳤다.

“왜 내가 하필 '멍청한 막내, 걔' 디아나 카르티에인 거야!?”

「결말이 세계 멸망일리 없어」 라는 소설에서 악행을 거듭하다가 악당에게 세뇌당해서 세계 멸망에 크게 일조하는 악녀, 디아나!
악녀는 뒤로 넘어져도 코가 깨진다더니, 나는 뒤로 넘어졌는데 전생을 기억해냈다?

전생에서 평범한 대학생이었던 나는 자신이 소설 속 악녀, 디아나 카르티에로 환생한 것을 깨닫고 마음을 먹었다.


“이 세상은 망할 거야.”
“하지만 내가 그렇게 두지 않을 거야.”

그래, 세계 멸망은 내 손으로 막아내겠어!
겸사겸사 오빠들도 음모에서 구하고!

잠깐. 저기 바닥에 널브러진 새카만 저건 뭐야?
잠깐.
저 얼굴, 어디서 분명 봤는데?

‘혹시 라이너스 델 슈타인!?’

당신이 왜 거기 쓰러져 있죠, 이 세상을 멸망 시키는 소설의 주인공 씨?

열심히 세계 멸망을 막으려 애를 쓰는 디아나와 오빠들!
그리고 귀여운 동물과 기타 등등?

우리 뽀짝 막내가 세계멸망을 막는 중이다, 길을 비켜라!

description.en: Jenesia, a brilliant sorcerer, was murdered after witnessing an affair between her fiancé and her best friend. With her final breath, Jenesia managed to use her magical powers to turn back time. Reliving her past, will Jenesia finally be able to find happiness?
description.fr: Yennesia était la plus jeune sorcière de la cour et la fille illégitime de Lambrice et avait un fiancé bien-aimé, le 4e prince Havaer Randy Hillon. Cependant, après que les recherches magiques qu'elle avait commencées pour son fiancé se soient soldées par un échec, sa vie fut bouleversée. Dès qu'elle est tombée en phase terminale, le fiancé en qui elle avait confiance l'a abandonnée... L'homme qu'elle aimait la trompait avec sa meilleure amie. La dernière décision de Yennesia fut d'utiliser sa magie afin de remonter le temps.
description.ko:
최연소 궁정 마법사이자 램브리체 가문의 사생아였던 예네시아.
사랑하는 약혼자의 부탁으로 시작했던 '시간 역행 마법 연구'가 
계속해서 실패하자 연구의 부작용으로 병까지 얻게 되었다.

심지어 사랑했던 약혼자가 자신의 절친과 바람을 피우는 것을 목격하고, 살해당한다. 

"고마워 예네시아. 이건 친구가 주는 마지막 선물이라고 생각할게."

예네시아는 끊어지는 숨을 겨우 붙잡으며 
마지막으로 '시간 역행 마법'을 시도해 보기로 하는데..!

altTitles.en: Elqueeness
Spirit King Elqueeness

description.en: When Ji-Hoon’s unfortunate life is tragically cut short, he is met with the revelation that he is another world’s Water Spirit King mistakenly born on Earth. Many trials await him as the new ‘Elqueeness’ in the fantastic world of Arkadon. Will he be able to forge new bonds and joyful memories, or will he be dragged into despair as a dark threat to his new world, life and companions is brewing?

altTitles.en: Drowning in Your Ocean

description.en: Jiwoo goes fishing with her father and snags a way bigger catch than she expected. The mermaid tangled in their net is injured, so they take her home and let her stay in their bathtub until she recovers. Meanwhile, the mermaid keeps flirting with Jiwoo, who hears a rumor that any human who betrays a mermaid's love will be cursed forever. Knowing this, Jiwoo feels anxious and can't get the annoyingly charming mermaid off her back fast enough. Or at least, that's what she keeps telling herself as she sinks deeper and deeper into a dangerous ocean...

Mr. Kim the Laborer is raking in the sweet profits with auto-hunting
Mr. Kim Is Living the Good Life with Auto-Hunting

description.en: An era where Awakened Ones and Hunters are active.Hajun, who lived as a day laborer at a construction site, awakens a unique ability called "Manpower Manager" one day . Just when he thought it was a useless skill with no combat capabilities, his summoned workers begin auto-hunting, conquering dungeons on their own...?! Hajun builds his own team by recruiting not only Orcs, Goblins, and Slimes but also top-tier workers with overwhelming talent. He then breaks world records and achieves results that even the strongest guilds cannot rival. While concealing his identity and expanding his influence, his presence gradually begins to attract the attention of the nation's top Hunters and powerful nations abroad...!

description.ko: 평범한 고등학생인 내가 별 생각 없이 찍은 동영상. 그 동영상이 '뒷세계‘에서 유행할 거라고는 상상도 못했다. 우당탕탕 뒷세계 학원 코메디.

Shard of Time

description.es-la: Una noche, una niña sirvienta se encuentra escapando de su sadico dueño noble, dirigiendose al lugar donde le dijo su persona mas querida ''alli hay 'álgo', pidele a ese 'álgo' que te proteja'' pero al llegar pasa algo inesperado...

altTitles.en: The Eldest Daughter Protects the Tang Clan
The Eldest Daughter of the Tang Clan of Sacheon Protects the Family

description.en: Betrayed by her husband and forced to watch her family perish, Sohwa Tang, the brilliant Master of Poisons, exacts ruthless revenge before taking her own life. But death isn't the end. Awakening as her 17-year-old self, she makes a fierce vow: protect the Sichuan Tang clan at any cost. She doesn’t care about righteous justice or martial world politics. Her only goal is her family's survival. Yet as she brutally eliminates future threats, the world misinterprets her ruthless pragmatism as noble acts of chivalry. Follow Sohwa as she accidentally becomes the martial world’s greatest heroine while simply trying to keep her family alive.
description.fr: Tang So-hwa est une génie du poison qui connaît absolument tous les poisons existants sous le ciel, surnommée le "Maître de la Dissolution de Tous les Poisons" (Mandokhaesa). À la suite de la trahison de son mari — le chef de la famille/secte Namgoong —, sa propre famille est totalement exterminée. Seule survivante, So-hwa massacre la secte Namgoong à l'aide du poison avant de se suicider. Mais à peine a-t-elle fermé les yeux, après avoir accompli cette vengeance tant espérée, qu'elle les rouvre pour s'apercevoir qu'elle est revenue à ses 17 ans, à l'âge d'or de la secte Tang de Sichuan... ?!

altTitles.en: I Faked a Pregnancy, but My Husband Returned

altTitles.pt-br: A Mentira Que. Trouxe Meu Marido de Volta

description.fr:
Judith se réveille un jour pour découvrir qu’elle est devenue, du jour au lendemain, une baronne criblée de dettes suite au décès de son père – puis elle se rend compte qu’elle s’est réincarnée dans un roman qu’elle avait lu dans sa vie antérieure. Décidant de mettre à profit sa connaissance de l’intrigue originale pour rembourser ses dettes, elle entre au service de la maison du duc en tant que belle-fille sous contrat, se faisant passer pour la fausse épouse du fils disparu de la famille. Rembourser les dettes, profiter des luxes qu’elle ne pourrait jamais s’offrir dans sa vie réelle… Ce n’est que pour quelques mois, alors pourquoi ne pas en profiter au maximum ? Mais voilà que le mari, qui, dans le roman original, ne revient jamais, revient.

« Alors vous êtes ma femme. Celle qui porte mon enfant. »

A filha do vilão planeja fugir

La fuga de la hija del villano

description.de: Nach 99 Leben als ‚Profi-Extra' erhält die unschuldig hingerichtete Herzogstochter Billicia eine besondere Macht: Regression! In ihrem 100. Leben will sie aber nicht fliehen, sondern das eisige Herz ihres gefürchteten Vaters erwärmen. Was kann da schon passieren...?
description.en:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!
I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?
description.es:
¡Reformaré a mi malvado padre para sobrevivir!
Me ejecutaron por ser la hija del villano. Creí que ahí terminaría mi vida, pero regresé en el tiempo a mi infancia. Sin dinero y sin fuerzas, decidí esperar a ser más grande para escapar de mi trágico destino. Aunque… ¿no sería mejor si purifico el oscuro corazón de mi padre en lugar de huir?
description.fr: Vilisa est la fille de Kasys Valois, le vilain de l’empire Rolls. Raison suffisante pour être condamnée à mort et exécutée par l’empereur. Mais lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, quatorze ans plus tôt, elle se retrouve face à l’événement qui a fait basculer son père dans la folie. Deux choix s’offrent à elle: s’enfuir avant de se retrouver sur l’échafaud ou rester et tenter d’apaiser le chagrin de Kasys. Mais quelles sont ses chances de transformer le vilain en papa poule?
description.it: Renderò buono il mio cattivo padre e sopravviverò questa volta! Sono stata uccisa perché ero la figlia del cattivo, ma quando ho aperto gli occhi, ero tornata indietro di 14 anni nel tempo. Troppo giovane e senza un soldo, ho deciso di aspettare per scappare... Ma perché dovrei scappare?! E se invece alleno mio padre a essere buono?
description.ko:
악역의 딸이라는 이유로 사형당했다.

‘이놈들아, 난 아무것도 안 했다고!’

억울해하며 눈을 뜨니 14년 전으로 돌아왔다.
아직 악역 가문의 보살핌이 필요한 나는 용돈을 모아 탈출하기로 계획했는데…

“죽이면 끝나는 거 아닌가. 골치 아프게 협상을 왜….”
“협상하는 아빠 조아.”
“협상하도록 하지.”

무려 인생 2회차. 금수저가 탈출을 왜 해!?
아빠를 조련해 착한 사람으로 만들었다.

히히. 세상 사람들.
이제 우리 아빠 악역 아니거든요!



아하, 샌드위치 만들다가 그런 거구나.
그럼 그럼!

우리 아빠는 이제 착해졌다구요!
description.th: ฉันจะทำให้คุณพ่อกลายเป็นคนดีและมีชีวิตรอดไปให้ได้! ฉันถูกฆ่าด้วยเหตุผลเพียงเพราะเป็นลูกสาวของคนร้าย พอฉันลืมตาตื่นขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง กลับพบว่าตัวเองย้อนกลับมาเมื่อ 14 ปีก่อน ที่ทั้งเด็กเกินไปและไม่มีเงินติดตัวเลยสักนิด ฉันเลยตัดสินใจที่จะรอสักพักก่อนจะหนี… แต่ทำไมฉันต้องหนีด้วยล่ะ? ในเมื่อฉันสามารถฝึกคุณพ่อให้เป็นคนดีได้นี่?
description.pt-br:
"Depois de 100 vidas como a filha do vilão, tudo o que quero é um final feliz."

Na minha 99ª vida, fui executada só por ser a filha do vilão. Quando voltei a abrir os olhos, percebi que tinha voltado 14 anos no tempo e que estava de volta sob os cuidados da família do vilão. Por causa disso, decidi que precisava juntar dinheiro para fugir. Mas e se eu conseguisse convencer meu pai a não ser mais um vilão e virar uma pessoa legal...?

altTitles.ja: 奇縁 〜 ゲームと現実がリンクする

altTitles.en: My Lucky Encounter From the Game Turned Into Reality

description.en:
"Who says revenge is vain? It's so fun!"

In a world where magic co-exists with the rule of nobles, Adrian Lawrence seemed to have gotten lucky in life as the second son of a viscount. Despite this, Adrian is an outcast in a home controlled by his scheming step-mother and half-brother, who are set on ousting him. 

Little do they know that Adrian plays the game Chronicle Online, where he possesses great powers that can also be used in reality! 

With heirship to the viscounty up for grabs, can Adrian use his powers to level up his real life?

altTitles.en: Angelic Lady

description.en:
Angela was my friend. I wanted to give anything to her, who I thought more precious than my own family. And I eventually turned Angela, a lowly aristocrat from the countryside, into the flower of the capital society. But it was betrayal that came back. She sold me and my family to become an imperial princess.

"…Did you have to go this far?"
"Because I wanted you to be unhappy. I wanted to take your whole life away."

But when I thought I had died under the guillotine, I was surprisingly back in the past.

"Oh, hello. My name is Angela Vito…"
"You're Angela! Nice to meet you. Everyone was waiting for you."

With a bright smile, I held her hands together again.

---
My best friend betrayed me! Born from a low-ranking noble family, Angela grew to be renowned for her beauty and grace, becoming the prized angel of society, all with my enthusiastic support. Yet beneath that glitz and polish, she was simply... evil. She used me and had me killed out of sheer spite in her quest to become the empire’s greatest woman. But unlucky for her, a magical gift from a dragon has given me a second chance at life. No longer blinded by her light, I’ll do all I can to stop her!
description.fr:
Angela était mon amie. J'aurai pu faire n'importe quoi pour celle que je considérais comme plus précieuse que ma propre famille. Et j'ai fini par transformer Angela, une humble aristocrate de la campagne, en la fleur de la société. En remerciement je n'ai reçu que mensonge et trahison. Elle nous a vendu, ma famille et moi, pour devenir une princesse impériale.

"…Fallait-il que tu ailles aussi loin?"
"Je voulais que tu sois malheureuse. Je voulais te prendre toute ta vie."

Et lorsque j'ai cru mourir guillotiné, je suis revenue dans le passé.

"Oh, bonjour. Je m'appelle Angela Vito…"
"Vous êtes Angela ! Ravie de vous rencontrer. Tout le monde vous attendait."

Avec un sourire éclatant, je lui ai de nouveau tenu les mains.

---
Angela est ma chère amie à qui j’ai donné tout mon cœur, et elle m'a remerciée... en me trahisant. Pour devenir princesse héritière, elle a détruit ma famille et m’a envoyée à la guillotine. Mais au moment de l'exécution, je suis remontée dans le temps comme par miracle pour me retrouver au jour de ma première rencontre avec elle. Cette fois-ci, je ne me laisserai pas faire: ce sera maintenant à mon tour la faire souffrir.

Julianne is as close to perfect as it gets: she’s got looks, talent, and smarts. The only problem is she has terrible taste in men! That’s why her little sister Lilianne is doing everything she can to make sure she doesn’t end up with the wrong guy. I was the only younger sister of the female protagonist in the reverse harem novel. In addition, I was exceptionally pampered by the female lead after waking up after being very sick. I used that to defeat the original inexcusable trash male leads who only hurt my sister…

‘Lili, how are you? Do you like cake?’

description.en:
The archmage who ruled over a magic kingdom. One day, she was reborn as the youngest daughter of the empire!

"I'll just play along and pretend to be a baby. …But don’t you think you guys like me a little too much?"

They won't leave her alone. The youngest princess is tired today as well.

---
Princess Enisha's birth marks the start of the Hyperion Empire's prophetic reign. With her unfathomably cute face and a ceaseless supply of loyal servants, life is pretty great for the baby princess. There's just the small issue of her two psychotic-killer brothers and a war-hungry father who she must stop from driving the empire into ruin. Enisha's got a lot on her plate, between the constant flood of assassins trying to kill her and those pesky memories of her past life. But she's in no rush to return to being the powerful high mage of a magical kingdom. After all, being Hyperion's one great hope certainly has its royal perks. It's not easy being the empire's beloved princess, but these subjects will just have to do.

description.en:
In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

---
In a brutal, lawless medieval world where war and poverty reign, and twisted magic defies all reason, the captain of the guards grinds through another grueling day, pushing his battered body to the limit in a land where survival itself is a merciless test.
description.fr: Aaron se retrouve propulsé dans un monde médiéval fantastique peuplé d’ignares, où le droit du travail n'existe pas. L’infâme ordure des gardes du château Casserdic va devoir tout faire pour survivre dans ce monde de guerre, de magie, de pauvreté... et de démons. Sans oublier, bien sûr, d’éduquer ces abrutis médiévaux.
description.id:
Terlempar ke dalam cerita fantasi berlatar abad pertengahan?! Dengan kondisi dunia yang sangat kejam dan dikuasai perang, sihir, serta berbagai hal aneh lainnya, Aaron harus menjabat sebagai ketua tim penjaga. Mampukah Aaron bertahan hidup di masa ketika hukum dan pandangan moral masih sangat primitif?

---
Di dunia abad pertengahan yang brutal dan tanpa hukum dimana peperangan dan kemiskinan merajalela, Serta magic gila yang membantah segala akal sehat, Kapten penjaga melalui hari baru yang melelahkan lagi, Memaksa tubuh lelahnya di tanah dimana bertahan hidup pun sudah seperti ujian yang keji.
description.ko:
노동법도 없는 무식한 중세.
전쟁과 빈곤, 마법과 비상식이 지배하는 이곳에서
경비조장은 오늘도 뺑이를 친다.
description.zh-hk: 轉生到這個沒有勞基法可言的中世紀異世界，轉眼間竟然已經過了六年……即使身懷不凡戰力，亞倫依然屈居警衛組長一職。就算他不願踏入任何紛爭，在這個貧富交錯、魔法縱橫的世界裡，衝突依然會不請自來。就在看似平凡的某一天，詭異的護送行動強行開啟了冒險的序幕！

description.en:
Dark World, the game I, a thirty-year-old salaryman, had devoted my entire youth to. 

"What the fuck is this…"

When I opened my eyes, Dark World had become my reality. The pouring rain, dripping hot blood, and a cold blade. At the moment of my impending death, I came into this familiar world.
A school bus crashes into an alternative world full of monsters. Amidst the hopeless despair, only the protagonist's Chat AI works.

description.es-la:
'Amor descontrolado',
Un manga de comedia romántica japonesa enormemente popular con más de 10 millones de copias vendidas.
Estaba poseído como Kim Yoo-sung, un extra que no tiene mucho protagonismo en ese cómic que nunca había visto antes.

Pero este tipo, 
Resulta que eres un auténtico otaku que incluso hace cosplay, ¿no?
Para una vida cómoda libre de dudas 
Dominaré todo tipo de narices del amor y haré de extra otaku.

¿Pero por qué se activa el cliché de la heroína cuando estoy contigo?
Y no solo uno—esto sería problemático, ¿verdad?

altTitles.en: Absolute Regression

description.en:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. 

Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him – even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. 

Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.
description.ko:
"나를 과거로 보내주시오."

이 시대에서 그를 죽일 수 없다면, 과거로 돌아가면 되리라. 시간을 거스를 수 있는 '회귀대법(回歸大法)'으로 그토록 원하던 과거로 회귀한 한 남자. 

가족도, 친구도, 삶도, 모두 잃었던 '검무극(劍無極)'의 복수를 위한 첫걸음이 시작된다.

description.en:
I "transmigrated" into a world I'd never seen before.

For 30 years, I believed I was living in a classic fantasy RPG.
I became a war hero, retired, and thought I was finally about to see the ending.
But...

Those 30 years were only the prologue.
It turns out the real story is about an academy?
description.ko:
처음 보는 세계에 ‘빙의’했다. 
왕도 RPG라고 생각하고 30년을 보냈다. 
전쟁영웅이 되어 퇴역했고, 이제 엔딩을 맞이할 예정이었다. 

그런데ㅡ 
지금까지의 30년이 프롤로그였고, 심지어 아카데미물이었다고?
description.ru: Я оказался внутри незнакомой игры. Решив, что это классическая RPG, я прожил в ней тридцать лет, стал героем войны, вышел в отставку и собирался спокойно провести оставшееся время. Но что? Всё это время это была история про академию?

description.en:
Heavenly Demons, Hunters, Giant Robots, Demon Kings, and Superhumans.

The strongest warriors from countless worlds gather in one place, with the survival of their respective worlds at stake.

In this battle for survival, where defeat means nothing less than the destruction of an entire world, the representatives of the “Ordinary World”—the only ones with no special powers whatsoever—are dragged into the conflict.

Just as they are about to be crushed by the overwhelming strength of monsters who exist far beyond normal standards, they are given an unexpected weapon.

[The abilities of your game character are being synchronized]

Can Shin Jahyeon and the representatives of the Ordinary World borrow the powers of their game characters, defeat the true strongest beings, and survive?

They connect instantly, but what begins as a sweet challenge becomes a risky game of affection on- and offline!
